text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing.
Trainer-san, are you hungry by any chance?
choice_data_list: Could this be an invitation or something?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Spot on! If you'd like,
would you come with me? My treat.

Heading to the cafeteria with a cheerful Royce and Royce,
there was a massive pile of vegetable soup packs waiting.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This is the soup I always keep stocked in my room.
It's nutritious, delicious, and easy to make—the ultimate cost-effective product!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It was on sale, so I bought in bulk!
Now I can host the "Royce-chan's Special! Vegetable Soup Grand Tasting Party"♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
For the rivals and friends who enrich the drama,
I'd really prefer them to stay healthy, after all.
choice_data_list: Are we having them drink it here?
Are we having them drink it here?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but that wouldn't be very fun on its own, would it?
I'm putting together something delicious AND fun,
so you can look forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Royce! Windy-chan
brought ingredients!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Soup is far too soft! I'll load it up with an all-star lineup of crunchy, chewy toppings and make it rock-solid!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Making sure everyone gets proper nutrition?
What an admirable goal!
I'll lend a hand too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Dried goods, root vegetables, and even meat and fish!
Thank you both so much.
With this, there's no doubt it'll be a massive success!
choice_data_list: What are you planning to use all of this for?
What are you planning to do with so many?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's—none other than "recipe variations"!
No matter how tasty something is, don't you think
you'd get sick of eating the exact same thing forever?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So! While promoting vegetable soup,
why not also gather ideas to keep things from getting repetitive?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I asked around a lot, so more materials should
keep coming in! Heheh, isn't this exciting?
The plan was certainly brilliant, but—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, Royce?
What are we supposed to do with this?

She must have asked countless people,
because the cafeteria table was quickly piled high
with ingredients right before our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that works out perfectly.
I was just thinking about researching side dishes
that would go well with soup.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Great taste, great nutrition, great value,
and on top of that, a menu you'll never get tired of!
Let's brainstorm the ultimate menu!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Sounds fun, this is my chance to show what I'm made of.
I'll make sure you go home completely stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this is incredible!
It's practically a full Manchu-Han imperial feast.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, maybe I went a little too hard on the hype.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all!
Windy-chan will chomp down
and crush every single bit of it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
We went to all the trouble to prepare this much.
It'd be a waste not to try everything!
choice_data_list: Then let's gather more people to eat it too.
Since we made it, let's enjoy every single bite!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. If we're going to do this,
I'd like to gather opinions as broadly as possible."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Understood! I'll break out our backup soup reserves to keep the hype going even stronger!

Thanks to Royce and Royce and the others spreading the word,
a large crowd of students gathered. The soup and food
sold out in no time flat.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Making it delicious so you never get tired of it was the whole goal from the start.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'll find the best arrangement
while balancing time efficiency and cost performance!"

And so, Royce and Royce polished off
the mountain of food together with her friends.
